integrity: Theorem reconstructed using algebraic fiber traces, polynomial area substitution and exact disk moments; finite symbolic checks supplement but do not replace the proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact pullback formula holds for bounded Borel targets of positive area, and capacity equality for monic polynomial inverse images of disks at degrees divisible by the map degree. No classification at other degrees or outside polynomial proper maps. A rotationally symmetric specialization was known in 2008; unindexed general transfer statements remain a historical-priority risk.
title: Polynomial pullback Bergman polynomials and infinite exactness of capacity least squares
